title: Conditional formalization of Zhou's Connes-rigidity counterexample
abstract: Constructs Zhou's two countable discrete groups and, assuming the project's universe-polymorphic property-(T) predicate for EL₃(𝔽₂[t]), proves that both satisfy the same predicate, are ICC and nonisomorphic, while their group von Neumann algebras are trace-preservingly normally star-isomorphic.

informal.Connes.theoremA: At any Hilbert-space universe, assuming property-(T) for EL₃(𝔽₂[t]), constructs two countable discrete ICC groups satisfying property-(T) at that universe which are nonisomorphic although their group von Neumann algebras are trace-preservingly normally star-isomorphic.

classification.branch: operator algebras and geometric group theory
